source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraftReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - MinecraftFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends.CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play!VIBRANT VISUALS* Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER** Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS* - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE NINTENDO SWITCH™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. **Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account. Online multiplayer functionality requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately).Software description provided by the publisher.Free upgrade!Happy news for those of you who already own a version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™! If you have a digital copy, you can upgrade to the digital Minecraft Standard Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2 for free*. For all players (including owners of a physical version), when you launch Minecraft for Nintendo Switch on your Nintendo Switch 2 between October 27, 2026, at 9AM PT and January 31, 2027, at 9AM PT, you’ll receive an in-game message inviting you to upgrade to digital Minecraft: ULTIMATE COLLECTION for Nintendo Switch 2 at a discount. *offer available through Nintendo eShop onlyLearn more about Minecraft: ULTIMATE COLLECTIONPublisher notification(s):Already own a digital version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™? Get a digital Minecraft Standard Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2 for free or pre-order the Deluxe Collection or Ultimate Collection at a discount by January 31, 2027.Related tagsActionSimulationChoose your own pathCreate and playFree roamingPlay in first- or third-personCross-platform playMeet up and play togetherOnline co-opPlay together on multiple consolesPlay together on one consoleShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)1.2 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)Local wireless (2-8)Online (2-8)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
